x.author: Boris Cherny
x.summary: Claude Code 开发者 Boris Cherny 近期分享了 AI 辅助编程的深度技术细节，揭示了 Claude 如何通过构建代码模型来定位并修复复杂 Bug。此外，他还公开了提升 Claude Desktop 应用性能的工程实践，并分享了与计算机科学泰斗 Donald Knuth 会面的珍贵瞬间。
x.translation:
【推文 1】今天在计算机历史博物馆见到 Donald Knuth 真是莫大的荣幸。

【推文 2】给形式化方法领域的朋友们多透露一点细节——Claude 目前的工作流程大致如下：1. 构建程序模型，针对棘手的状态机或易产生竞态条件的代码部分；2. 在模型中寻找反例，即疑似 Bug；3. 复现这些 Bug；4. 修复代码中的 Bug。这并非意味着整个代码库都经过了形式化验证（目前还不行！），而是针对代码中最复杂的部分进行建模、检查反例并进行修复。

【推文 3】如果你注意到 Claude 官网和桌面端应用在过去几周变快了，这就是我们的实现方式。博客文章中包含了大量针对工程师的实战经验和优化技巧，适合那些正在为自家应用进行性能加速的开发者们。
x.recommendation: Boris 揭示了 AI 从简单的代码补全向‘模型驱动的自动化调试’进化的路径，为 AI 工程化提供了极具价值的参考。其性能优化博文则是提升复杂应用响应速度的实战指南，非常值得构建 AI 产品的开发者深入研读。

rawTweets.text: It was an honor to meet Donald Knuth at the Computer History Museum today https://t.co/U6bGOidLmw

More details for the formal methods people -- what's happening is Claude is doing something like:

1. Building a model of the program, targeting a tricky state machine or race-prone part of the code
2. Finding counter-examples in the model. These are suspected bugs
3. Reproducing the bugs
4. Fixing the bugs in the code

It's not that the whole codebase is formally verified (yet!..), more that the hairiest parts of the code are modeled, checked for counter-examples, and fixed.

If you've noticed how fast https://t.co/9A6X5iqpbs and the Desktop app have become in the last few weeks, here's how we did it. 

Lots of juicy learnings & techniques in the blog post for engineers working on speeding up your own apps. https://t.co/42Zcob1Udq

x.author: Madhu Guru
x.role: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
x.summary: Meta AI 高管 Madhu Guru 反驳了关于 AI 代理（Agent）的观点，指出消费者对不同任务的交互需求存在本质差异。他认为，AI 的核心价值在于针对“低愉悦感、高摩擦”的任务实现零门槛交付，而非一刀切地改变所有消费行为。
x.translation:
我不得不委婉地反驳 @benthompson 的观点。他忽略了一个关键点：消费者与“完成任务”之间的关系并非单一的。我在 Google 和现在的 Meta 多年深耕消费级及中小企业产品，对此深有体会。

浏览服装对某些人来说是娱乐，但雇佣屋顶维修工对大多数人来说却是种折磨。

即便是购物，有时你想花一小时慢慢挑选，有时你只想以最快速度拿到心仪商品。

他的论点听起来很像 21 世纪初的陈词滥调：
“我为什么要在线买衣服？我得试穿一下。”
“我为什么要在线买 500 美元的电视？我得去 Circuit City 看看实物。”

技术一直在提供更好的做事方式。

看看今天雇佣一个屋顶工有多麻烦：搜索、读 10 条评论、电话拉锯、对接保险、安排检查、获取报价、防范隐形费用、审查过往案例、雇佣、排期。

对于这类任务，所谓的“更好”意味着几乎零成本的交付；而对于其他任务，则意味着权衡更多选项、享受过程并做出明智决策。

市场对于能够消除此类消费摩擦的 AI 代理存在着巨大的潜在需求。
x.recommendation: 该观点精准拆解了 AI Agent 的产品哲学：不要试图用统一的交互逻辑覆盖所有场景。对于开发者而言，识别出那些“高摩擦、低愉悦”的痛点任务，才是 Agent 落地最直接的商业机会。

rawTweets.text:
I respectfully disagree with @benthompson on this. He’s missing a key point - Consumers don’t have one relationship with “doing things”. 

I’ve learned it the hard way from building consumer and smb products for years at Google and now Meta.

Browsing clothes can be entertainment (for some). But hiring a roofer is miserable (for most).

Even with shopping, sometimes you want to browse for an hour. Sometimes you want the right thing just delivered asap.

His argument sounds a lot like the early 2000s:

“Why would I buy clothes online? I need to try them on.”

“Why would I buy a $500 TV online? I will go check it out at Circuit City.”

Technology keeps giving you better ways of doing things.

Try hiring a roofer today: search, read 10 reviews, phone tag, coordinate with insurance, schedule inspection, get quotes, catch hidden costs, review their past work, hire, scheduling.

For some tasks like this, better means almost zero effort. For others, it means considering more options, enjoying the process and making an informed decision.

The latent demand for agents that remove this friction for consumers is immense.

x.author: Guillermo Rauch
x.summary: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 深入拆解了 AI Agent 的架构，提出将“大脑、双手、文件”解耦以实现云端高效运行。同时，他发布了 Sandbox 的配套存储服务 Drives，并分享了利用 AI 优化终端启动速度的实践经验。
x.translation:
ShellPerfBench。我对新 Shell 会话的启动时间有着近乎神经质的执着。Opus 5.5 发现了很多其他模型错过的绝佳优化方案。各位，每当你打开一个新的终端时，可能都在默默忍受延迟。让你的 Agent 去优化 .zshrc 等配置文件吧。

Muse、Instinct、OpenClaw、Claude Code……所有成功的 Agent 都具备三个核心组件：
🧠 大脑 → 模型、控制逻辑 (harness)
👐 双手 → 工具、计算机、浏览器
🗃️ 文件 → 记忆、技能、代码库

“简单”的做法是把这些全部塞进一台有状态的计算机（如 Mac Mini）里。比如你在 Mac 上运行 claude 或 fx，通过 caffeinate 让它全天候运行，它拥有存储、CLI 和安装好的应用。但如果你想在云端经济高效地运行 Agent，就需要拆解这些部分。

🧠 控制逻辑可以在流式计算中运行。为了在重启、发布、崩溃时保持可靠性，你可以使用 Workflow 让事件日志持久化。
👐 双手可以是专用的浏览器集群（如 Browserbase/Kernel）、计算机（如 Sandbox），甚至是更轻量的工具（如 just-bash）。
🗃️ 🆕 缺失的一环是解耦存储。想象一下，你希望每晚运行一个记忆巩固的定时任务（“做梦”），你可以直接读写文件，而无需“启动”Agent 的整台计算机。

今天，我们推出了 Sandbox 的完美搭档：Drives。我们已经为 Agent 提供了计算机，现在我们为你提供可以随时挂载的“外接硬盘”。目前还处于早期阶段，我们将迅速扩展其功能。

顺便提一下，将 Agent 拆解为这些独立部分，不仅能大幅优化成本，还能显著提升安全性和可审计性。我甚至认为，如果不这样做，你根本无法运行一个安全的 Agent！
x.recommendation: Rauch 提出的“Agent 架构解耦”是构建生产级 AI 应用的关键范式，从单体架构转向微服务化 Agent 架构，对于降低云端推理成本及提升安全性具有极高的参考价值。此外，他将终端优化与 AI 结合的思路，展示了 AI 在开发者工具链中“微小但高频”的应用潜力。

rawTweets.text: ShellPerfBench. I'm really neurotic about the startup time of a new shell session. Opus 5.5 found a lot of really great optimizations other models missed. Anon, anytime you open a new terminal, you might be silently suffering. Tell your agent to optimize .𝚣𝚜𝚑𝚛𝚌 and friends

Muse, Instinct, OpenClaw, Claude Code…
All successful agents have 3 key components:

🧠 Brain → model, harness (logic)
👐 Hands → tools, computer, browser
🗃️ Files → memories, skills, repos

The 'easy' way is to throw all these in 1 stateful computer (a Mac Mini)

Like, you run 𝚌𝚕𝚊𝚞𝚍𝚎 or 𝚏𝚡 in your mac, you keep it running all day with 𝚌𝚊𝚏𝚏𝚎𝚒𝚗𝚊𝚝𝚎, it has storage, and CLIs and apps installed.

But if you want to cost-efficiently run agents in the cloud, you actually start breaking down these parts.

🧠 The harness can run in Fluid compute. To make it reliable across restarts, rollouts, crashes, you make its event log durable using Workflow.

👐 The hands can be a dedicated browser fleet like Browserbase/Kernel, a computer like Sandbox, and even more efficient lightweight tools like just-bash.

🗃️ 🆕 What was missing was a way to also decouple storage. Imagine you want to run a memory consolidation cron job every night ("dreaming"). You can read/write to the files directly without 'booting up' the agent's full computer.

Today we're introducing the perfect companion to Sandbox: Drives. We shipped the computer for agents, now we're giving you the 'external disk' you can attach at will. It's early, and we'll be expanding capabilities here quickly.

Btw, breaking apart the agent into these independent parts not only optimizes costs in a big way, it also *massively* improves security and auditability. I'd argue you can't even run a secure agent otherwise!

Great vision for the future of the creative industry with AI from the one person who can actually predict these things.

“As the barriers and the costs come down, more films will get made, not fewer. Studios will get to take more risks. There will be more seats at the table, and very soon entirely new forms of storytelling. In the 1980s, animation was dismissed as a niche corner of the business. Today it is one of the most beloved and profitable forms of storytelling in the world. In live action, filmmakers like Steven Spielberg, James Cameron and Peter Jackson embraced new visual tools not as shortcuts, but as instruments, and expanded cinema in the process. Every time storytelling has met a genuine technological shift, from synchronized sound to color to computer animation, it has redefined the boundaries of the medium and grown larger in the process.”

Technology has reshaped the creative industry over and over through the years, and has generally always led to an expansion of opportunity or new approaches as a result. 

And even when the techniques or mediums change, the underlying need for creative skills and taste don’t go away. Just more people are able to leverage those skills effectively when a new technology arrived, and users of the tools discover novel new ways to tell stories.

x.summary: Cursor 与 Notion 前设计师 Ryo Lu 发文反思 AI 时代的“效率陷阱”。他指出，AI 不应仅仅用于加速生产“垃圾内容”或管理更多代理，而应成为人类探索想象力与深层意图的画布，呼吁从业者从盲目追求速度转向追求“辨识力”。
x.translation: 效率、生产力、速度——我们像崇拜生命意义一样崇拜这些词汇。更快地发布、合并更多代码、管理更多智能体、压缩每一个循环、消除每一次停顿、将每一小时转化为产出。但如果连深度思考的时间都没有，无休止的生产又有什么意义？不是反应、不是优化、不是总结、不是处理队列，而是思考。在问题中沉淀足够久，直到真实的意图浮现；在忙碌之下寻找目的；去质疑那些被加速的事物是否真的有存在的必要。AI 本可以是一张全新的画布，一种创造奇特、个性化、甚至不可能之物的途径——工具、世界、诗歌、游戏、界面、电影、语言、仪式，让更多人触及自己想象力的形状。但现实是，它正变成一座座“平庸工厂”：更多的内容、更多的漏斗、更多的工单、更多伪装成价值的虚假工作。你可以合并 2000 个 PR，可以管理 500 个智能体，可以在醒来时看到仪表盘证明机器在你睡觉时仍在运转。但如果你每天只睡 5 小时，这有什么意义？如果你不再与人交谈、不再学习历史、不再玩耍、不再漫游、不再感到惊喜，这有什么意义？如果你的整个人生变成了优化那个正在吞噬你的系统，这又有什么意义？速度不等于意义，规模不等于智慧，如果自动化只是让每个人跑得更快，那它就不是自由。我们究竟在向哪里奔跑？奔向一个每个人都成为机器管理者，而机器生产出无人有时间去真正渴望的东西的世界吗？危险不在于 AI 会让我们变懒，而在于它让我们变得无休止地忙碌。它在我们找到意图之前就给予了无限的生产力，在培养出品味之前就给予了无限的执行力，在学会静止之前就给予了无限的运动。也许真正的边界不在于速度，而在于“辨识力”——知道什么不该做，知道何时该停下，知道何时最有生产力的事是睡觉、阅读历史、给朋友打电话、逗猫、不带追踪设备地散步，或者盯着天花板直到虚假的紧迫感消散。工具应该赋予我们更多生活，而不是将生活变成工具。如果 AI 真的有意义，它不应只是帮我们生产更多，而应帮助我们变得更具人性、更有想象力、更自由。否则，它只是旧时代的工厂，只不过这次没有了人类。
x.recommendation: 作为 Cursor 等顶尖 AI 工具的设计者，Ryo Lu 的反思极具警示意义。对于 AI 从业者而言，这篇推文提醒我们：在追求 Agent 规模化与自动化效率的同时，必须警惕“为了生产而生产”的虚无，回归以人为本的创造力内核。

rawTweets.text:
efficiency, productivity, speed

we keep worshipping these words like they are what we live for

ship faster
merge more
manage more agents
compress every loop
remove every pause
turn every hour into output

but what is the point of endless production if there is no time left to think deeply?

not react
not optimize
not summarize
not clear the queue

think

to sit with a question long enough that your real intention starts to appear  
to find the purpose underneath the motion  
to ask whether the thing being accelerated should exist at all

ai could be a new canvas

a way to make strange things
personal things
impossible things
tools, worlds, poems, games, interfaces, films, languages, rituals
things that let more people touch the shape of their own imagination

but instead, so much of it is becoming slop factories

more content
more funnels
more tickets
more fake work pretending to be value

you can merge 2000 prs
you can manage 500 agents
you can wake up to dashboards proving that the machine kept moving while you slept

but what is the point if you only sleep 5 hours a day?

what is the point if you stop talking to other humans?
stop learning about the past?
stop playing?
stop wandering?
stop being surprised?

what is the point if your whole life becomes optimizing the system that is consuming you?

speed is not meaning
scale is not wisdom
automation is not freedom if it only makes everyone run faster

and where are we running?

toward what?

a world where every person becomes a manager of machines, and every machine produces more things no one had the time to truly want?

the danger is not that ai makes us lazy

the danger is that ai makes us endlessly busy

that it gives us infinite production before we have found intention
infinite execution before we have developed taste
infinite motion before we have learned how to be still

maybe the real frontier is not more speed

maybe it is discernment

knowing what not to make
knowing when to stop
knowing when the most productive thing is to sleep, read history, call a friend, play with a cat, walk without tracking it, or stare at the ceiling until the false urgency dissolves

tools should give us more life
not turn life into a tool

if ai is going to matter, it should not just help us produce more

it should help us become more human  
more imaginative
more free

otherwise, it’s the same old factory
just without humans

x.summary: 前Facebook高管Aditya Agarwal近日发文点评扎克伯格的领导力，并分享了关于团队建设的独到见解。他强调，相比团队规模，团队成员的共事时长（Longevity）才是衡量产出效率与韧性的核心指标。
x.translation:
【推文 1】你以为扎克伯格在低谷、深陷困境、处于封锁状态或战时模式时表现出色？那你得看看他在手握重筹时是如何主导全局的。作为Facebook的前员工，我深感自豪。冲吧。

【推文 2】一个人职业生涯的频繁变动能说明很多问题，同样，一家公司极低的员工流失率也说明了很多问题。一个共事超过3年的团队，其吞吐量和韧性远高于刚组建的团队。投资者和求职者常犯的一个关键错误是只关注团队规模，而非团队的存续时长。团队的“曲线下面积”（AUC，即团队协作时间的累积）才是衡量团队价值的正确指标。
x.recommendation: Aditya提出了“团队AUC”这一极具洞察力的度量标准，提醒AI初创公司在招聘与融资时，应优先考虑团队的磨合深度而非单纯的人数堆砌。同时，他对扎克伯格领导力的评价，也为理解大厂在AI转型期的战略执行力提供了独特视角。

blogs.translation: Twelve months ago, we'd have rejected out of hand the idea of granting Claude access sufficient to take down an internal Anthropic service. Today that level of access is routine, and Anthropic developers are more productive for it. The risk of these deployments has two components: how likely a failure is, and how much damage one could do. blogs.translation: Get started with Claude Managed Agents by following our docs . A running topic on the Engineering Blog is how to build effective agents and design harnesses for long-running work .
